verse.verse_2: And thou shalt be allowed in yonder city -
verse.verse_3: And by the begetter and that which he begat,
verse.verse_4: Assuredly We have created man in trouble.
verse.verse_5: Deemest he that none will overpower him?
verse.verse_6: He saith: 'I have wasted riches plenteous.
verse.verse_7: Deemest he that none beholdeth him?
verse.verse_8: Have We not, made for him two eyes
verse.verse_9: And a tongue and two lips,
verse.verse_10: And shown Unto him the two highways?
verse.verse_11: Yet he attempteth not the steep,
verse.verse_12: And what shall make thee understand that which the steep is?
verse.verse_14: Or, feeding, in a day of privation,
verse.verse_16: Or a poor man cleaving to the dust.
verse.verse_17: Then he became of those who believed and enjoined on each other steadfastness and enjoined on each other compassion.
verse.verse_18: These are the fellows of the righthand.
verse.verse_19: And those who disbelieve Our signs - they are the fellows of the lefthand.
verse.verse_20: Over them shall be Fire closing round.
